title: Character report
description:
Read one character and print a short report about it:

```
Character: g
Code: 103
Uppercase: G
Is a letter: true
Is a digit: false
```

Use `std::toupper`, `std::isalpha` and `std::isdigit` from `<cctype>`, and `std::boolalpha` so that `bool` values print as `true` and `false`.

Those three functions return an `int`. Convert `std::toupper`'s result to `char`, and compare the other two with `!= 0` to get a real `bool`.
hints: `std::cout << (std::isalpha(c) != 0)` needs the brackets: `<<` binds more tightly than `!=`.

examples.name: lower-case letter
examples.expected:
Character: g
Code: 103
Uppercase: G
Is a letter: true
Is a digit: false

examples.name: digit
examples.expected:
Character: 7
Code: 55
Uppercase: 7
Is a letter: false
Is a digit: true
